acceptance: PiRpcClient::spawn stores, from the handshake and before PiRpcSession::new consumes it, the models (id, name, provider), the thinking levels, the current model id and the current thinking level in new Inner fields. New public methods (all take &self): `config_options(&self) -> Vec<SessionConfigOption>`; `applied_model(&self) -> String` (the current model value as "provider/id", empty string if there are no models); `set_model(&self, value: &str) -> Result<(), String>`; `set_thinking_level(&self, level: &str) -> Result<(), String>`

config_options returns up to two select options. (1) id "model", name "Model", category Model, one SessionConfigSelectOption per Pi model with value "provider/id" and name = the model's name (fall back to the id when the name is empty), current value = the model whose id equals the stored current model id (first match; if none match, the first model); omitted when there are no models. (2) id "thought_level", name "Thinking", category ThoughtLevel, one option per thinking level (value and name both the level), current value = the stored thinking level (if it is not in the list use the first level); omitted when there are no levels. Values reflect the latest successful set_model / set_thinking_level

set_model splits value on the FIRST '/' into provider and modelId (no '/' -> Err("model must be provider/id")), calls session.request("set_model", json!({"provider": p, "modelId": m}), Duration::from_secs(10)) and on Ok stores value as the current model (update both the stored model id and provider); Err passes Pi's error text through unchanged. set_thinking_level calls request("set_thinking_level", json!({"level": level}), Duration::from_secs(10)) and on Ok stores the level. Both return Err when the session was shut down

pi_rpc_client_options_tests.rs (declared in mod.rs as `#[cfg(test)] mod pi_rpc_client_options_tests;` next to pi_rpc_client_tests) tests: config_options shape and current values (model option category Model, current "fake-provider/fake-model", 2 options; thought_level category ThoughtLevel, current "medium", 4 options); set_model success updates applied_model() and the model option's current value; set_model on "fake-provider/does-not-exist" -> Err containing "Model not found" and state unchanged; set_model("noslash") -> Err; set_thinking_level("high") updates the thought_level option's current value
